claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User initiates generation of treatment quality and trend reports.
The system permits the report/print option according to the user's login permission.
The system passes data from the Database to the Reports module, including output from claim processing.

The system generates treatment quality and trend reports as specified in the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study', including summaries of all providers, quarterly summary reports per provider and summarizing all providers, frequencies of syndromes treated, patient population sex and age, frequencies of primary clients and notified partners, numbers of correctly documented cases, cases with incorrect documentation, cases treated according to algorithms, cases with justified treatment alterations, treatment errors, provider comparisons regarding syndromes treated, documentation quality, and treatment behaviour, and quarterly and half-yearly time-trend reports for each provider and all providers combined.

claims.content: Treatment quality and trend reports have been generated as specified in the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study'.

The generated treatment quality and trend reports include summaries of all providers; quarterly summary reports per provider and summarising all providers; frequencies of syndromes treated; patient population sex and age; frequencies of primary clients and notified partners; number of correctly documented cases; cases with incorrect documentation; cases treated according to algorithms; cases with justified treatment alterations and treatment errors; provider comparisons regarding syndromes treated, documentation quality and treatment behaviour; and quarterly and half-yearly time-trend reports for each provider and all providers combined.
If the MSIU Field Office User has the specific 'User Login Permission' for printing, the system provides an option to print the generated report.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User wants to generate treatment quality and trend reports as specified in the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study'.
The MSIU office has processed the collected claim forms from the VSP.

The system contains the treatment quality and trend data required for the reports, including frequencies of syndromes treated (with patient population sex and age), primary clients, notified partners, correctly documented cases, treatment errors, and provider comparisons.
The system generates reports on treatment quality and trends.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates generation of treatment quality and trend reports.
The system permits the report/print option according to the user's login permission.
The system passes data from the Database to the Reports module, including output from claim processing.

The system generates treatment quality and trend reports as specified in the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study', including summaries of all providers, quarterly summary reports per provider and summarizing all providers, frequencies of syndromes treated, patient population sex and age, frequencies of primary clients and notified partners, numbers of correctly documented cases, cases with incorrect documentation, cases treated according to algorithms, cases with justified treatment alterations, treatment errors, provider comparisons regarding syndromes treated, documentation quality, and treatment behaviour, and quarterly and half-yearly time-trend reports for each provider and all providers combined.

Diverges from Step 1: instead of initiating generation of the standard treatment quality and trend report, the MSIU Field Office User selects the customized report option in the Reports (Standard and Customized) module; the system generates a customized report variant.

Diverges from Step 2: when the MSIU Field Office User has login permission to generate or view reports but does not have print permission, the system allows the treatment quality and trend reports to be generated and viewed without permitting printing.
Diverges from Step 4: the system generates an analytical, medical, or statistical report variant, rather than the standard report specified in the Programme Design Study.

Report generation depends on successful prior data processing (e.g., Claim Processing, Voucher Creation); failure in these upstream steps constitutes an exception condition preventing report generation.
Treatment quality and trend reports have been generated as specified in the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study'.

The generated treatment quality and trend reports include summaries of all providers; quarterly summary reports per provider and summarising all providers; frequencies of syndromes treated; patient population sex and age; frequencies of primary clients and notified partners; number of correctly documented cases; cases with incorrect documentation; cases treated according to algorithms; cases with justified treatment alterations and treatment errors; provider comparisons regarding syndromes treated, documentation quality and treatment behaviour; and quarterly and half-yearly time-trend reports for each provider and all providers combined.
If the MSIU Field Office User has the specific 'User Login Permission' for printing, the system provides an option to print the generated report.
